# Thora

## Overview

- **Age:** 40  <sub>[v3 ch.Coming” P2](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0002), [v3 ch.Last P51](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0051)</sub>
- **Role:** cook  <sub>[v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Thora is a tall woman, though not excessively so, with a somewhat plump figure that maintains a controlled silhouette. She has a cheerful face with pink cheeks, large and gentle eyes as blue as forget-me-nots, and a head of soft, wavy brown hair with a single strand of grey styled in a bun.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)_

## Personality

Thora is recognized as a joyful, frugal, and patient individual. She is also an absolute master in the kitchen.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Fairlie P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008)_

## History

Thora lived at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road), where she hosted [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) as a lodger and was courted by her long-term suitor, [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md). After twenty years of courting without a proposal, Thora broke down to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and subsequently rejected John coldly following a prayer meeting. However, after John's mother passed away, John explained that his late mother had forced him into a secret vow not to marry while she was alive; he then proposed, and Thora agreed to marry him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Cressida P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Cressida P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009), [v3 ch.Fairlie P2](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0002), [v3 ch.Fairlie P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), +10 more_

## Quotes

> "Goodness, my expectations of your appearance were completely off. I felt certain your hair would be dark—darkness was a trait of my sister Nell. Yet red is the color of yours!"
>
> — Thora — [v3 ch.Cressida P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003)

> “Why was I not told about this?” Thora inquired with a choke. “If I had merely been aware! Why did you not simply let me know?”
>
> — Thora — [v3 ch.Last P43](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0043)

> “Your perspective on numerous matters will change once you reach my age,” Thora remarked with tolerance. “Learning how to forgive is among the lessons age brings us. Doing so is simpler at forty than it was at twenty.”
>
> — Thora — [v3 ch.Last P51](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0051)

> "The thing is, Nell, my affection for John has always been huge. Since no one else could ever be the one for me, his continued visits were perfectly fine, making it a non-issue."
>
> — Thora — [v3 ch.Coming” P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)

> "No, I suppose I do not. All the same, I was scared to attempt it, fearing he would believe I was serious and simply leave. I am likely a weak-willed person, yet that is my feeling. And I am unable to change it."
>
> — Thora — [v3 ch.Coming” P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thora.md)

[Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) becomes Thora Sweet's lodger and companion at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) after moving into her [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road) house. The two bond as friends, sharing personal stories and laughing over unexpected events like a neighbor's awkward marriage proposal to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) plays a pivotal role in Thora's romantic life by encouraging her to confront her long-time courtier, [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), over his lack of a proposal, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) briefly regrets the resulting cold rejection until John's family situation comes to light.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Cressida P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), +12 more_

- Friend of — landlady and companion  <sub>[v3 ch.Cressida P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Last P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024), [v3 ch.Last P45](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0045)</sub>
